candidates.purpose: Add a separate live-web discovery source and URL-to-Markdown fetch path for coverage comparisons.
candidates.stars_or_community: Not applicable; hosted proprietary API, no public code repository identified.
candidates.license_commercial: No software license. Metered hosted service; commercial-use terms not fully reviewed.
candidates.install: No local install; API key and HTTPS JSON requests to api.deepseek.com.
candidates.novelty: First-party search index API plus on-demand fetch; not a reranker-only package.
constraints: Japanese recall and unique-result rate unmeasured
fetch depends on target-site access policy
API terms and account enablement not verified
candidates.verification_value: Compare fixed Japanese queries against current independent-index targets; measure new-domain/unique-relevant URLs, official-source recall, date accuracy, fetch-success, and cost per useful URL.

candidates.commercial: MIT code; upstream model API usage remains subject to its own price and terms.
candidates.runtime: Python >=3.11; matplotlib, numpy, pydantic, openai, tqdm; OpenAI-compatible API key/base URL.
candidates.hardware: No GPU or minimum RAM claim. Offline MCCFR/CFR baseline work runs locally; duration and RAM unreported. Goofspiel run imports OpenSpiel, absent from base pyproject dependencies.
mechanism: Goofspiel opponent action likelihood over last q_window records (default 10).
EMA posterior update with default alpha 0.85; per-game belief snapshots.
Top-three similar-case retrieval gated on current step >=3 and similarity gradient.
API-generated counterfactual consideration memory, saved and reused in prompts.
CFR/MCCFR equilibrium strategy as prior plus LLM adjustment using opponent belief and case evidence.
candidates.offline_cost_requirement: LLM training-free, but equilibrium strategy is separately precomputed: Leduc default max 500000 CFR+ iterations with exploitability target 0.01; Liar's Dice setup 500000 iterations, threshold 0.01; Goofspiel MCCFR default 500000 iterations. Wall-clock and RAM unreported.
candidates.api_model_id: Paper used DeepSeek V4 Flash; current canonical DeepSeek API ID is deepseek-flash (V4.1-Flash-1017). Legacy deepseek-v4-flash is accepted but routed to current Flash, so paper results are not version-pinned/reproducible by alias.
candidates.novelty: Structured inference-time baseline policy + soft opponent belief + state-similar counterfactual cases, beyond fixed if-else personality branches.
constraints: Only Leduc Hold'em, Liar's Dice, Goofspiel evaluated
No evidence it transfers to the user's Unity game
API cost and experience-memory refresh cost unmeasured
authors' payoff/token claims not independently replicated
candidates.verification_value: Design a bounded offline comparison for maintain/change/abandon decisions using probabilistic opponent behavior, recent tactical states, and counterfactual case evidence; assess decision freshness, allowed-action validity, and API cost.

screened_out.reason: README requires predownloaded local test corpus/nginx and CMake Docker setup; no current update date, operational API, or Japanese index evidence verified. Not a substantiated archive-free new site discovery design.
